title: Measurement Observation
description: The recorded result of a Measurement. A MeasurementObservation is a sibling of the existing assessment-side dea:Observation (CR-5 27) on the assessment-vs-measurement axis; the two are distinct concepts and MUST NOT be merged, re-membershiped, or supersed-ed. (CR-MET-001 binding ADR-MET-002; user clarification 2026-10-18; full attribute set in CR-MET-003 and CR-MET-011.)

produced_by.description: Reference to the dea:Measurement that produced this observation. Cardinality 1:0..1 (a MeasurementObservation is the result of one Measurement; a Measurement MAY produce zero or more observations).

value.description: The recorded value. Typed to support the four measurement_nature values from the parent Metric: numeric (number), ordinal (number or string), nominal (string), boolean (boolean), composite (object). (CR-MET-003 binding CR-MET-001.)

observed_at.description: Time the value was observed (CR-MET-003 binding). Required.

valid_from.description: Start of validity period. Conditional on observations that have a validity period concept.

valid_to.description: End of validity period. Conditional on observations that have a validity period concept.

reporting_period_start.description: Start of the reporting period represented by this observation. Recommended.

reporting_period_end.description: End of the reporting period represented by this observation. Recommended.

observation_status.description: Validity or supersession status (CR-MET-003 binding). Required. The 4-value enum covers proposed -> active -> superseded -> retired.

verification_state.description: Verification state of the observation value (CR-MET-004). An ai_assisted Measurement MUST NOT produce an independently_verified or human_verified observation unless an independent verification step occurred. An ai_estimated observation is NOT equivalent to a verified observation for reporting, aggregation, or comparison.

supersedes_observation.description: Reference to the prior observation this observation corrects. The prior observation is retained with observation_status: superseded (CR-MET-004 correction semantics).

provenance_reference.description: Origin and lineage. Recommended. Full provenance model in CR-MET-011.

uncertainty_reference.description: Reference to the measurement uncertainty (CR-MET-005 binding handle). Full uncertainty model is CR-MET-012.

comparability_requirements.description: Comparability requirements for this observation (CR-MET-005 binding). Documents any conditions under which this observation is comparable to others (e.g. same Unit, same Scale, same reporting period, same population).

precision.description: Significant figures for the observed value (CR-MET-005 binding).

unit.description: Optional reference to the unit registry per CR-MET-005. Required when the parent Metric has measurement_nature: numeric.

temporal.description: Temporal context (when the value was obtained). Full specification in CR-MET-011.

confidence.description: Optional confidence value in the range 0..1.
